key: RANDALL: I'm sure, whenever I'm meant to go home, that key will find its way to me somehow.
en: RANDALL: I'm sure, whenever I'm meant to go home, that key will find its way to me somehow.
ja: ランドール: おれが家に帰るべきときが来たら　あのカギは　どうにかしておれのところに　戻ってくるはずさ

key: In fact, that's why I picked up ol' Klefki here!
en: In fact, that's why I picked up ol' Klefki here!
ja: だからこそ　このクレッフィを　拾ってきたんだよ!

key: Little feller's like a magnet for lost keys, so every now and then I check if he picked it up.
en: Little feller's like a magnet for lost keys, so every now and then I check if he picked it up.
ja: こいつは　なくしたカギを　引き寄せる磁石みたいなもんでね　たまに　拾ってないか　確かめてるのさ

key: No dice so far, but I'm figurin' it's only a matter of time.
en: No dice so far, but I'm figurin' it's only a matter of time.
ja: 今のところ　当たりはねぇが　時間の問題だと　思ってるよ

key: By the ways, I don't suppose you's thinkin' something like...
en: By the ways, I don't suppose you's thinkin' something like...
ja: ところで　まさか　あんた　こう思っちゃいねぇよな……

key: "Wait a second, weren't he just in that Night Club?
en: "Wait a second, weren't he just in that Night Club?
ja: 「ちょっと待てよ　こいつ　さっきナイトクラブに　いなかったか?

key: Surely you ain't in two places at once!"
en: Surely you ain't in two places at once!"
ja: まさか　同時に二か所には　いられねぇだろ!」ってな

key: And you'd be right as rain, I ain't.
en: And you'd be right as rain, I ain't.
ja: で　その通りさ　おれは　そんなことしちゃいねぇ

key: No one's gonna be spendin' their whole day behind a counter, you know?
en: No one's gonna be spendin' their whole day behind a counter, you know?
ja: 一日中　カウンターの奥に　こもってるやつなんて　いねぇだろ?

key: I been back-and-forthin' it between here and there to keep up on my reading.
en: I been back-and-forthin' it between here and there to keep up on my reading.
ja: 読書を　続けるために　あっちとこっちを　行ったり来たりしてるんだよ

key: If it seems like I'm in two places at once, it's prolly just a coink-a-dink.
en: If it seems like I'm in two places at once, it's prolly just a coink-a-dink.
ja: もし　おれが　二か所にいるように見えたなら　そりゃ　ただの偶然さ

key: RANDALL: Hey, if it ain't--
en: RANDALL: Hey, if it ain't--
ja: ランドール: おっと　こいつは――

key: Well, whatever your name were.
en: Well, whatever your name were.
ja: まあ　あんたの名前が　何だったにせよ　だ

key: Good to see ya made it out of Gehovasect witness' place or what you ever had that was.
en: Good to see ya made it out of Gehovasect witness' place or what you ever had that was.
ja: 「ゲホバセクトの証人」とかいうとこから　うまく　抜け出せたみてぇで　なによりだ

key: I sallied on outta there a bit ago... Fell back into some bad habitats...
en: I sallied on outta there a bit ago... Fell back into some bad habitats...
ja: ちょいと前に　そこから　飛び出してよ……　また　悪い習慣に　逆戻りしちまってな……

key: But now here I am again, and doing better than ever!
en: But now here I am again, and doing better than ever!
ja: だが　こうして　また戻ってきて　前より　調子がいいんだ!

key: This shelter openin' up is a blessing better than their Arceus whatnot could ever hope to give.
en: This shelter openin' up is a blessing better than their Arceus whatnot could ever hope to give.
ja: このシェルターが　できたのは　あの連中の　アルセウスがどうのってやつより　よっぽど　ありがたい恵みだよ

key: The staff are real friendly and all, and look at all the books they helped me collect!
en: The staff are real friendly and all, and look at all the books they helped me collect!
ja: スタッフは　みんな親切でよ　見てくれ　こんなに本を　集める手伝いを　してくれたんだ!

key: To tell the truth, I've still got a lot more books back home, but variety is the spicy life, right?
en: To tell the truth, I've still got a lot more books back home, but variety is the spicy life, right?
ja: 実を言うと　家には　まだまだ本が　あるんだが　いろいろあってこそ　人生ってもんだろ?

key: Still, it'd be nice to be able to go home someday.
en: Still, it'd be nice to be able to go home someday.
ja: それでも　いつか　家に帰れたら　いいんだけどな

key: I live here in ol' Reborn, of course.
en: I live here in ol' Reborn, of course.
ja: もちろん　ここリボーンに　住んでるんだ

key: The only problem is...
en: The only problem is...
ja: ただ　一つ　困ったことがあってよ……

key: I done lost my key to my house.
en: I done lost my key to my house.
ja: 家のカギを　なくしちまってな

key: So I tried to call the locksmith, right? But any ID I got was in there, and the property ain't even in my name--
en: So I tried to call the locksmith, right? But any ID I got was in there, and the property ain't even in my name--
ja: それで　カギ屋を　呼んだんだが　身分証は　全部　家の中でよ　しかも　持ち主名義も　おれじゃねぇもんだから――

key: So they just assumed I was bamboozlin' them to break into some poor fellow's homestead.
en: So they just assumed I was bamboozlin' them to break into some poor fellow's homestead.
ja: だから　おれが　誰かの家に　勝手に押し入ろうと　だましてるだけだと　思われちまってな

key: I could break a window or somethin' somethin'...
en: I could break a window or somethin' somethin'...
ja: 窓でも　割っちまえば　いいのかもしれねぇが……

key: But at that point I decided, fate don't want me to be at home right then.
en: But at that point I decided, fate don't want me to be at home right then.
ja: だが　そのとき　思ったんだ　運命が　おれを　家に帰したくねぇんだろうって

key: So I adopted vagrancy and whimsituditnousness into my daily life!
en: So I adopted vagrancy and whimsituditnousness into my daily life!
ja: そんなわけで　放浪と　気まぐれを　日々の暮らしに　取り入れることに　したのさ!

key: It's been quite an experience, even if I am feelin' the tail end of it.
en: It's been quite an experience, even if I am feelin' the tail end of it.
ja: なかなかの経験だったよ　もっとも　そろそろ　潮時かもとは　感じてるがな

key: I'm sure, whenever I'm meant to go home, that key will find its way to me somehow.
en: I'm sure, whenever I'm meant to go home, that key will find its way to me somehow.
ja: おれが家に帰るべきときが来たら　あのカギは　どうにかしておれのところに　戻ってくるはずさ

key: Ah, say there, that wouldn't happen to be my key that you's holdin' on to?
en: Ah, say there, that wouldn't happen to be my key that you's holdin' on to?
ja: ああ　そういや　あんたが持ってるそれ　もしかして　おれのカギじゃ　ないよな?

key: \PN handed over the 'R' Key.
en: \PN handed over the 'R' Key.
ja: \PNは　「R」のカギを　わたした

key: Well, I'll be damned. You're a better Klefki than Klefki is.
en: Well, I'll be damned. You're a better Klefki than Klefki is.
ja: こいつは　驚いた　あんた　クレッフィより　クレッフィらしいじゃねぇか

key: Guess that means I can go home at any time.
en: Guess that means I can go home at any time.
ja: ってことは　いつでも　家に帰れるってわけだ

key: Well, I've still got a lot I'd like to finish reading here, so I'll mosey on home whenever I wrap up.
en: Well, I've still got a lot I'd like to finish reading here, so I'll mosey on home whenever I wrap up.
ja: まあ　ここで　まだまだ読み終えたい本が　あるからよ　キリがついたら　のんびり　家に帰るとするか

key: Can't help but think that might be a mite borin' for Klefki if I won't be travellin' around now though...
en: Can't help but think that might be a mite borin' for Klefki if I won't be travellin' around now though...
ja: もっとも　もう　あちこち　旅して回らねぇとなると　クレッフィにゃ　ちいとばかし　退屈かもなぁ……

key: I think you'll get more use out of 'er than I will now.
en: I think you'll get more use out of 'er than I will now.
ja: あんたのほうが　こいつを　うまく使ってやれると　思うんだ

key: Why don't you take care of 'er?
en: Why don't you take care of 'er?
ja: こいつの　面倒　見てやってくれねぇか?

key: It's been real, partner.
en: It's been real, partner.
ja: 世話になったな　相棒

key: RANDALL: I've still got a lot I'd like to finish reading here, so I'll mosey on home whenever I wrap up.
en: RANDALL: I've still got a lot I'd like to finish reading here, so I'll mosey on home whenever I wrap up.
ja: ランドール: ここで　まだまだ読み終えたい本が　あるからよ　キリがついたら　のんびり　家に帰るとするか

key: Zzz...
en: Zzz...
ja: スースー……

key: Ugh, trying to do homework in a place like this is infuriating!
en: Ugh, trying to do homework in a place like this is infuriating!
ja: ああもう　こんなとこで　宿題やろうなんて　イライラするったら!

key: I can't go three minutes without a random stranger bothering me!
en: I can't go three minutes without a random stranger bothering me!
ja: 見ず知らずの誰かに　三分と　邪魔されずには　いられないんだから!

key: Yes, that means you!
en: Yes, that means you!
ja: そう　あんたのことだよ!

key: Blankets, pillows, towels, rations here.
en: Blankets, pillows, towels, rations here.
ja: 毛布　まくら　タオル　食料は　こちらです

key: If you're missing anything, please don't hesitate to ask!
en: If you're missing anything, please don't hesitate to ask!
ja: 何か　足りないものが　あれば　遠慮なく　お申し付けください!

key: Our supplies are low, but we will do our best to provide for you as well as we can!
en: Our supplies are low, but we will do our best to provide for you as well as we can!
ja: 物資は　少なくなっていますが　できる限り　みなさまに　行き渡るよう　努めます!

key: Hey, keep it on the DL from staff... but I'm packin' candy if you need a level up.
en: Hey, keep it on the DL from staff... but I'm packin' candy if you need a level up.
ja: なあ　スタッフには　ないしょだぜ……　レベルアップが　必要なら　アメを　持ってるんだ
